notes:
Quick notes from recent calls: 
- QuillCraft is a small developer tools studio (VS Code extension focused). Building a paid copilot plugin — inline suggestions + streaming completions for real-time typing.
- Primary asks: low-latency streaming (inline completions appear seamlessly as dev types), ability to pin model versions per extension release, and fine-grained rate limiting & token quotas per user/team.
- Security: must integrate with customer SSO (SAML) and provide KMS-encrypted keys; audit logs for token usage and prompts; data residency preferences for EU customers.
- Cost sensitivity: wants predictable unit economics; interested in Optimize recommendations (batching/caching) to keep per-user cost under $0.03/hour at target concurrency.
- SE feedback: can meet median latency targets in hosted setup with continuous batching disabled for inline mode; Dedicated considered if production concurrency exceeds 5000 daily active devs.
- Quoted: "We need streaming so suggestions populate as soon as the keystroke lands — anything >100ms feels laggy to power users."
- Next: finalize latency SLA, agree POC success criteria (p95 <120ms for inline suggestions, end-to-end), and legal sign-off on ephemeral prompt retention (30 days).
